# SOP-P1-L2-01 Line startup - Ring Rolling line

Revision: Rev B  
Plant: P1, line P1-L2  
Equipment: EQ-P1-L2-RR01, EQ-P1-L2-IH02, EQ-P1-L2-HT03

1. Preconditions
   1.1. Verify plant utilities available and stable per ECN-2026-009.  
   1.2. Confirm preventive maintenance completed on EQ-P1-L2-RR01, EQ-P1-L2-IH02, EQ-P1-L2-HT03 per SB-1008.  
   1.3. Ensure material traceability documents present and match work order per SB-1020.

2. Personal Protective Equipment (PPE)
   2.1. Mandatory: safety glasses, heat-resistant gloves, steel-toe footwear, hearing protection, and face shield during furnace and induction operations.  
   2.2. Use insulated handling tools for hot billet transfer.  
   2.3. Restrict non-essential personnel from the immediate equipment area until sign-off.

3. Startup sequence
   3.1. Power-up and controller self-checks for EQ-P1-L2-RR01. Confirm no active faults before enabling roll drive.  
   3.2. Energize EQ-P1-L2-IH02 and confirm billet positioning sensors report ready. Confirm lubricant part number for Ring Rolling induction billet heater #2 (EQ-P1-L2-IH02) is CFW-LUB-788.  
   3.3. Bring EQ-P1-L2-HT03 to operational mode and confirm safety interlocks. The quench delay maximum for Ring Rolling heat treat furnace #3 (EQ-P1-L2-HT03) is 24 seconds. Monitor quench sequence to ensure delay does not exceed this value.  
   3.4. Feed first billet to EQ-P1-L2-RR01 at technician direction; observe roll engagement and material tracking for one complete revolution cycle. Abort on abnormal noise or motion.

4. Fault response
   4.1. If any interlock trips, stop feed, isolate equipment, and notify maintenance per ECN-2026-009.  
   4.2. Record fault codes and actions taken on the electronic log.

5. Sign-off
   5.1. Operator: print name, badge ID, signature, time.  
   5.2. Shift Lead: verify startup parameters, confirm PPE compliance, sign and date.  
   5.3. Maintenance: confirm no outstanding open work orders affecting safety, sign.

References: ECN-2026-009, SB-1008, SB-1020
